discovery.title: What do you believe in?
discovery.intro: Describe a trend, sector or technology you expect to grow. VicTy reads it, shows you what it understood and only then suggests approved instruments.
discovery.howItWorks: How it works: you write a thesis, check our interpretation, review a suggested composition and decide whether to buy. Nothing is bought without your approval in your wallet.
discovery.limitedUniverse: VicTy covers a limited set of approved instruments, so some theses may be only partly represented. We always say so when that happens.
discovery.suggestedTitle: Or start from a suggested thesis
discovery.suggestedError: We could not load the suggested theses. You can still write your own thesis above.
discovery.suggestedEmpty: There are no suggested theses right now. You can still write your own above.
discovery.quotaUsed: You have used your free interpretation. Connect your wallet to interpret another thesis. Suggested theses stay available.
discovery.interpreting: Interpreting your thesis. This usually takes a few seconds.
discovery.failedTitle: We could not interpret your thesis

interpretation.title: This is what we understood
interpretation.curatedNote: This is a suggested thesis prepared by VicTy.
interpretation.partial: Only part of this thesis can be represented with the instruments VicTy approves.
interpretation.blockedReason: Answer the open question to continue
interpretation.insufficientTitle: We cannot represent this thesis yet
interpretation.insufficientDescription: VicTy does not have approved instruments that match this thesis well enough, and we will not offer a substitute that misleads you. This is a valid answer, not an error.
interpretation.insufficientFootnote: No fit is better than a poor one. Try a suggested thesis or reword yours.
interpretation.loadFailedTitle: We could not load this interpretation
interpretation.updateFailedTitle: We could not save that correction
interpretation.confirmFailedTitle: We could not prepare the composition
